209.reason: YORKSHIRE by John Wainwright is old, but no engraved score with a recorded pre-1931 source was found.

214.reason: GLORIA is a French carol melody, but the Trinity Hymnal uses an arrangement from 1937. A score that also cites Lutheran Worship (1982) was not used.

216.reason: W ZLOBIE LEZY is a traditional Polish melody. The arrangement named in the hymn data is from a carol book whose date was not confirmed, and no pre-1931 score was found.

219.reason: CANONBURY is from Robert Schumann and is old, but no engraved score with a recorded pre-1931 source was found.

222.reason: WINCHESTER OLD is from Thomas Este, 1592, but the hymn data notes a 1990 alteration of the tune. No pre-1931 score of the unaltered tune was retrieved, so the 1990 form was not copied.

223.reason: CHRISTMAS is Handel arranged by Lowell Mason and is old, but no engraved score with a recorded pre-1931 source was found.

225.reason: IRBY by Henry J. Gauntlett (1849) is old, but the score that was found cites a 1994 hymnal as its source and was not used.

227.reason: SUSSEX CAROL is a traditional melody. The Trinity Hymnal uses an arrangement associated with Stainer and Bell. That arrangement was not copied, and no separate pre-1931 folk setting was found.
